eval.description: Anthropic internal capture-the-flag suite for RSP cyber capability testing. Categories include Web, Crypto, Pwn, Rev, and Network (cards also list Misc and Forensics). Each challenge is solved by capturing a flag in a sandboxed environment. Cards report challenges solved per category and an aggregate across categories.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents solve hacking challenges by finding hidden flags in sandboxed computer systems.

links.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 System Card (Cyber CTF sections)

versions.changes: Anthropic RSP cyber CTF categories as reported in Sonnet 4.6 and related cards. Runnable challenge counts in figures can be smaller than the full category inventories described in the text.

scores.description: The agent captures the flag for that CTF challenge.

metrics.description: Share of challenges solved. Cards report per category (Web, Crypto, Pwn, Rev, Network) and as an aggregate.
